Ravi P: FYI started onboarding Ledger's LoRA into rwd/base-v2 + ran a quick 1k smokepack with q4_0 -> seeing numeric token splitting (e.g., "Invoice 412" -> "Invoice 41 2").
Mira K: ouch. command?
Ravi P: `./ci/smoke_run.sh --model rwd/base-v2 --adapter ledger-lora.safetensors --quant q4_0 --batch 32 --seed 7`
Chen Li: metrics? short summary pls.
Ravi P: EM 0.79 -> 0.60, F1 0.80 -> 0.64, unk_token_rate 0.25% -> 2.1%, avg_token_split_rate ~1.9%.
Mira K: tokenizer hashes/vocab identical? sometimes int4 shifts logits across token boundaries.
Ravi P: checked hashes, vocab size identical. Repro locally: digit-boundary token shows up in ~2% of examples.
Alex S: try lowering adapter alpha (0.6) and use `--merge-order=postnorm` then quantize after merge. Ordering matters for q4 kernels.
Chen Li: also try merging then running per-layer scale calibration (or act-order rescale). If still bad, quantize adapter separately (int8) and merge to see difference.
Ravi P: re-ran merge alpha=0.6 + postnorm -> quantize. EM improved to 0.72, unk down to 0.6%. Better but still tail.
Alex S: capture failing samples and add to a focused eval subset (numeric-amounts) for regression alerts.
Chen Li: infra-bot: provision short dedicated run (2xA10) for a 2k Ledger smokepack, with stable seed and full token-level logging.
infra-bot: Scheduled run 7913579033 on dedicated-qa-a10-2 (ETA ~4m). Logs: /runs/7913579033/, will post output here when done. :gear:
Ravi P: saved failcases to s3://redwood-smoke/ledger/fails/7913579033.jsonl. If tails persist plan B = tiny adapter patch with token-remap for digit clusters + new eval alert.
Mira K: good plan. also add a daily regression alert: EM drop >0.05 on numeric-amounts slice.
Alex S: once infra run completes, let's decide whether to ship alpha-rescale + remap or escalate to author for adapter re-export.
Ravi P: will update thread with infra results and attach 10 representative failing inputs. :thumbsup:
